name: Empty stage dip (a breath between sections)

source.description: Two inspected product films (batch 1, 2026-11-26) clear the content to the bare background for a fraction of a second before the next headline types in.

technique: Instead of crossfading scene into scene, the outgoing content leaves and the bare background holds for 0.15-0.4 s, then the next section's headline enters. The empty frame is a full stop: the viewer resets before the new idea.
purpose: Separate sections or chapters; give the next claim a clean entrance; a visual breath that matches a pause in the narration or the music.
visual_behaviour: Cards and text fade or sink 8-16 px over 0.25-0.4 s; the background (with its vignette, grid or slow drift) shows alone; the next headline types or rises in.
mechanics: Outgoing group opacity 1 -> 0 and y +8..16 px over 0.3 s (power2.in); hold the empty stage 0.15-0.4 s while background drift and texture keep moving (never a frozen frame); next title enters (typewriter or line-mask rise). Snap the next title to the first word of the next narration phrase, so the dip sits inside the narration pause.

decomposition.timing: Exit 0.25-0.4 s; empty hold 0.15-0.4 s; entrance 0.4-0.8 s.

parameters.name: entrance
parameters.description: How the next title enters: typewriter, rise

use_cases: before a big claim or stat
failure_modes: Holds longer than about 0.5 s with narration running break the no-static-frame rule
A dip to pure black on a light film reads as a glitch; dip to the film's own background
On every scene change it slows the film; use at section turns only

implementation.approach: Studio.fx.dip(tl, out, in, at, {exit 0.3, hold 0.25}) (runtime 1.18.0): `at` is when the next title starts; the outgoing group sinks and fades to end `hold` before it; warns over 0.5 s of hold. The golden scene keeps a background drift and a persistent kicker through the hold.

priority.note: High value for narrated explainers: the dip lives in the pause between narration phrases.

provenance.observed: The reply scene fades out over about 0.3 s to the bare dark vignette, which holds empty for about 0.25 s before the next headline types in at 18.3-18.4 s.
The plant demo card drops away and the white canvas is briefly empty before 'Not a week.' types in.
The line leaves and the empty black stage (header only) holds 0.05-0.2 s before the next line types in, at 4.02, 11.95-12.02, 27.95-28.10 and 73.94-74.14 s.
The table and map leave and the empty textured page holds briefly (seen on one overview frame, so under 0.75 s) before the next headline enters (13.15 and 19.16 s).
Content fades out to the empty cream page (34.6-35.0 s) before the next headline types in.
Each section fades to an empty card shell for about 0.07-0.1 s (4.53-4.67 s) before the next headline builds: shorter than the 0.15-0.4 s dips recorded so far.
The app window is empty for about 0.1 s between card sections (3.16 s) and after the album dims (9.92 s); an accent lands on the empty beat at 3.16 s.
On a black film, five section breaks: content fades in 0.2-0.3 s, the black background holds 0.05-0.13 s (0.7 s before the closing section at 41.27 s), then the next kicker or headline types in.
On a light film the UI fades to the empty ivory canvas, which holds about 0.4 s before the wordmark types on (26.6-27.4 s).
Each claim dissolves to the empty glowing background for about 0.1-0.3 s before the next headline builds (7.67-7.97 s; 10.16-10.36 s; 12.54-12.84 s).
The page is empty at 44.17 s between the end line and the wordmark typing in (44.9 s).
The price cards leave and the bare canvas holds 53.45-53.62 s before the end card's first line fades in.
Content dissolves out and the bare background holds about 0.13 s before the next headline (13.42-13.55 s); a pale-blue empty beat before the cover rises (20.62-20.75 s).

Dips through the white page background between sections of a 3D explainer: out 72.33-72.53 s, empty about 0.05 s, up 72.57-72.83 s with the title typing (30 fps strip); the same at 22.21-22.39 s and 50.33-50.50 s.
Fade to black (15.78-15.91 s) and the next title fades up (15.94-16.04 s); again 16.71-16.77 s with the next card in at 16.81 s.
The green section fades out to the cream page (12.12-12.32 s) and the next sticker builds on the empty page.
